summary: The diagram illustrates the architecture of a Transformer model, a key component in modern natural language processing. It shows the flow of data through the model, starting with input embeddings and positional encoding, followed by multiple layers of multi-head attention and feed-forward networks. The process includes 'Add & Norm' operations, which are repeated Nx times, indicating multiple layers. The right side of the diagram represents the decoder with masked multi-head attention, which processes outputs shifted right. The final layers include linear transformation and softmax to produce output probabilities. This architecture is crucial for tasks involving sequence-to-sequence learning.
